Context: 1. Immediate relief to the family of an employee who dies while in service

4. Payable to the person(s), in the same manner as payment of death gratuity, if the deceased was governed by Pension Rules, or the balance in the Contributory Provident Fund Account, if the deceased was a subscriber to the CPF.
